html:
Juan Pablo Pérez Alfonzo was a Venezuelan lawyer and minister of mines who was one of the founders of OPEC in 1960. He later called oil "the devil's excrement".

As a minister in the governments of Rómulo Betancourt, he raised the state's share of oil profits and stopped new concessions to foreign companies. He worked with the Saudi oil minister Abdullah Tariki to bring the big exporters together, and in September 1960 they founded the Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries, OPEC, in Baghdad.

In the oil boom of the 1970s he warned that easy oil money was bringing waste, debt and corruption, and that Venezuela was drowning in it. His warning is often cited as an early statement of the resource curse, borne out in the history of Venezuelan oil.
sum: Juan Pablo Pérez Alfonzo was a Venezuelan lawyer and minister of mines who was one of the founders of OPEC in 1960. He later called oil "the devil's excrement".
